entities.name: Conditional Reconfiguration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE evaluates conditions for candidate target SpCells and applies conditional reconfiguration when conditions are met.

entities.name: ConditionalReconfiguration IE
entities.description: Information element containing configuration parameters for target SpCells and lists for conditional reconfiguration management.

entities.name: condReconfigToRemoveList
entities.description: List within ConditionalReconfiguration IE indicating conditional reconfigurations to be removed.

entities.name: condReconfigToAddModList
entities.description: List within ConditionalReconfiguration IE indicating conditional reconfigurations to be added or modified.

entities.name: Conditional Reconfiguration Removal Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for removing conditional reconfigurations as specified in clause 5.3.5.13.2.

entities.name: Conditional Reconfiguration Addition/Modification Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for adding or modifying conditional reconfigurations as specified in clause 5.3.5.13.3.

entities.name: Candidate Target SpCell
entities.description: Target SpCell configured by the network in conditional reconfiguration for UE evaluation.

entities.name: Execution Condition
entities.description: Condition associated with a candidate target SpCell that must be fulfilled for conditional reconfiguration application.

relations.description: UE evaluates conditions for candidate target SpCells as part of conditional reconfiguration procedure.
Procedure execution is guarded by execution conditions associated with candidate target SpCells.
ConditionalReconfiguration IE contains the condReconfigToRemoveList for removal procedures.
ConditionalReconfiguration IE contains the condReconfigToAddModList for addition/modification procedures.
Presence of condReconfigToRemoveList triggers conditional reconfiguration removal procedure.
Presence of condReconfigToAddModList triggers conditional reconfiguration addition/modification procedure.
Conditional reconfiguration procedure is defined based on the received ConditionalReconfiguration IE.
